breakdown.description: The prompt specifies an adiabatic (perfectly insulated) wall, which means zero heat flux. However, the boundary condition is set to `fixedValue`, which imposes a constant temperature (a Dirichlet condition), not a zero-flux condition (a Neumann condition).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification is merely a question about velocity boundary conditions on the cavity walls. It does not address the inconsistency regarding the bottom wall temperature boundary condition at all. The error of using `fixedValue` (Dirichlet condition) instead of `zeroGradient` (Neumann/zero-flux condition) for the adiabatic bottom wall was not identified or corrected.
